schemes.benefit: On-the-job technical training across 703 courses with direct monthly DBT stipend: ₹8,000/mo (Class 12), ₹8,500/mo (ITI), ₹9,000/mo (Diploma) and ₹10,000/mo (Degree)
schemes.description: Earn-while-you-learn employment training program with direct bank payments across private industries in MP.

schemes.name: Vahli Dikri Yojana (Dear Daughter Scheme)
schemes.brief: ₹1,10,000 cumulative grant from school entry to adulthood for girl child in Gujarat
schemes.briefHindi: गुजरात की बालिकाओं को कक्षा 1 से 18 वर्ष की आयु तक कुल ₹1,10,000 की वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: ₹4,000 at admission to Class 1, ₹6,000 at Class 9 admission, and ₹1,00,000 on turning 18 for higher education or marriage (applicable for first 2 girls of family)
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1 में ₹4,000, 9वीं में ₹6,000 और 18 वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर उच्च शिक्षा या विवाह हेतु ₹1 लाख
schemes.description: Incentivizes girl child survival and education in Gujarat with substantial milestone-based savings grants.

schemes.name: Dalit Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
schemes.brief: ₹10 Lakh 100% direct grant (no loan, no repayment) for SC families to start businesses in TS
schemes.briefHindi: दलित परिवारों को उद्यम शुरू करने हेतु ₹10 लाख का 100% अनुदान (बिना बैंक ऋण व बिना वापसी)
schemes.benefit: Direct financial grant of ₹10,00,000 per eligible Scheduled Caste family deposited into a dedicated bank account for starting any enterprise, transport, retail or manufacturing business
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति एससी परिवार ₹10 लाख की एकमुश्त अनुदान राशि — बिना किसी बैंक गारंटी या पुनर्भुगतान के
schemes.description: Groundbreaking financial empowerment scheme granting ₹10 Lakh outright capital to Scheduled Caste families to become business owners.

schemes.name: YSR Cheyutha Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.brief: ₹75,000 over 4 years (₹18,750/year) for women aged 45-60 from SC, ST, BC, Minorities in AP
schemes.briefHindi: एससी, एसटी, बीसी और अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग की 45-60 वर्ष की महिलाओं को 4 साल में ₹75,000
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹18,750 per year for 4 continuous years (total ₹75,000) coupled with technical support from ITC, Amul, P&G for sustainable livelihood businesses
schemes.benefitHindi: सालाना ₹18,750 (4 साल में ₹75,000) सीधा बैंक खाते में अमूल/आईटीसी से किराना व डेयरी व्यापार हेतु
schemes.description: Financial and entrepreneurial assistance for middle-aged women belonging to marginalized social categories.

schemes.name: Snehapoorvam Scheme (Kerala)
schemes.brief: ₹300 to ₹1,000/month scholarship for children who lost father/mother and live with relatives
schemes.briefHindi: माता-पिता को खो चुके और रिश्तेदारों के साथ रह रहे बच्चों को ₹300 से ₹1,000/माह छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial aid from Class 1 through degree: ₹300/mo (Class 1-5), ₹500/mo (Class 6-10), ₹750/mo (Class 11-12) and ₹1,000/mo (Degree/Professional) to ensure children never abandon studies
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1 से कॉलेज तक ₹300 से ₹1,000 प्रति माह नियमित छात्रवृत्ति सीधे बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Compassionate welfare safety net of Kerala Social Security Mission preventing destitute orphans from falling out of formal schooling.

schemes.name: SMILE Scheme (Support for Marginalized Individuals)
schemes.nameHindi: स्माइल योजना (हाशिए पर रहने वाले व्यक्तियों की आजीविका सहायता)
schemes.brief: Rehabilitation, skill training, and medical cover for transgender persons and destitute
schemes.briefHindi: किन्नर समुदाय व भिक्षावृत्ति में संलग्न व्यक्तियों का पुनर्वास एवं निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Skill development training with ₹1,000/month stipend, composite healthcare cover under PM-JAY, and micro-enterprise loans up to ₹5 Lakh
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण + ₹1,000/माह वजीफा तथा ₹5 लाख तक का रियायती ऋण
schemes.description: Umbrella scheme for comprehensive rehabilitation and livelihood assistance for marginalized individuals.

schemes.name: NAMASTE Scheme (National Sanitation Workers Mission)
schemes.nameHindi: नमस्ते योजना (राष्ट्रीय सफाई कर्मचारी आजीविका मिशन)
schemes.brief: Up to ₹5 Lakh capital subsidy for sanitation workers to buy mechanized cleaning equipment
schemes.briefHindi: सफाई कर्मचारियों को आधुनिक सीवर सफाई मशीन खरीदने हेतु ₹5 लाख तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy up to 50% (max ₹5 Lakh) for buying mechanized cleaning vehicles, free PPE safety kits, and health insurance under PM-JAY
schemes.benefitHindi: सफाई मशीन/वाहन खरीदने पर 50% तक (अधिकतम ₹5 लाख) सरकारी सब्सिडी व आयुष्मान सुरक्षा
schemes.description: Ensures zero human entry into sewers by providing mechanized cleaning equipment with generous subsidies.

schemes.name: PM POSHAN Shakti Nirman (Hot Cooked Meals)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम पोषण शक्ति निर्माण योजना (गर्म पौष्टिक भोजन)
schemes.brief: 100% free daily hot cooked nutritious meals for all students from Balvatika to Class 8
schemes.briefHindi: बालवाटिका से कक्षा 8 तक के सभी विद्यार्थियों को 100% मुफ्त गर्म पौष्टिक दोपहर का भोजन
schemes.benefit: Free wholesome hot meals providing 450-700 calories and 12-20g protein daily on every school working day for 12 Crore school children
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1 से 8 तक के प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी को स्कूल में प्रतिदिन मुफ्त गर्म व पौष्टिक भोजन
apply_mode: Direct enrollment in any Government or Government-Aided School
schemes.description: National school feeding program enhancing enrollment, attendance, and nutritional status of primary students.

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
schemes.brief: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakh for goat, sheep, poultry and piggery farms
schemes.briefHindi: बकरी, भेड़, मुर्गी और सुअर पालन फार्म स्थापित करने पर 50% तक (₹50 लाख तक) सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Direct 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50 Lakh for poultry, ₹50 Lakh for sheep/goat breeding farms, and ₹25 Lakh for fodder seed processing)
schemes.benefitHindi: पशुपालन फार्म और हैचरी शुरू करने पर लागत का 50% (अधिकतम ₹50 लाख) सीधा बैंक अनुदान
schemes.description: Financial assistance and capital subsidies for sustainable development of poultry, sheep, goat, and piggery entrepreneurship.

schemes.name: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (DEDS)
schemes.brief: 25% to 33.33% back-ended capital subsidy via NABARD for dairy farm units
schemes.briefHindi: नाबार्ड के माध्यम से 2 से 10 दुधारू पशुओं की डेयरी खोलने पर 25% से 33% बैक-एंडेड सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: 25% capital subsidy (General) up to ₹1.25 Lakh and 33.33% subsidy (SC/ST) up to ₹1.67 Lakh for setting up small modern dairy farms (up to 10 animals)
schemes.benefitHindi: दुधारू पशु, मिल्किंग मशीन व गोबर गैस हेतु 25% (सामान्य) व 33.33% (एससी/एसटी) नाबार्ड सब्सिडी
schemes.description: Promotes setting up of modern dairy farms for clean milk production with back-ended capital subsidy from NABARD.

schemes.name: Prime Minister Development Initiative for North East (PM-DevINE)
schemes.department: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
schemes.brief: 100% central funding for infrastructure and livelihood empowerment in North East states
schemes.briefHindi: पूर्वोत्तर भारत के 8 राज्यों में आजीविका, स्वास्थ्य व युवा रोजगार हेतु 100% केंद्रीय अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Dedicated infrastructure projects, bamboo processing clusters, youth incubation, and rural entrepreneurship programs across Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Arunachal & Sikkim
schemes.benefitHindi: पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों के युवाओं व किसानों के लिए आजीविका क्लस्टर, बांस उद्योग व कौशल विकास
schemes.description: High-impact central scheme filling developmental gaps and promoting livelihoods in all eight North Eastern states.

schemes.name: UDAN (Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik - Regional Connectivity)
schemes.nameHindi: उड़ान योजना (उड़े देश का आम नागरिक)
schemes.brief: Capped affordable flight airfares (₹2,500/hour) connecting 500+ unserved regional routes
schemes.briefHindi: छोटे शहरों के लिए किफायती हवाई यात्रा — 1 घंटे की उड़ान का किराया अधिकतम ₹2,500 निर्धारित
schemes.benefit: Air travel made affordable for common citizens with fare capped at ₹2,500 per seat per hour of flying on regional routes connecting tier-2 & tier-3 cities
schemes.benefitHindi: छोटे शहरों से बड़े महानगरों तक किफायती टिकट दर पर रियायती हवाई सेवा
documents: Government Photo ID Card / Aadhaar Card
schemes.description: Regional airport development and air connectivity program making flying accessible to common citizens across India.

schemes.name: PRASHAD Scheme (Pilgrimage & Heritage Tourism)
schemes.nameHindi: प्रसाद योजना (तीर्थयात्रा कायाकल्प और आध्यात्मिक संवर्धन अभियान)
schemes.brief: World-class amenities, clean restrooms, drinking water, and e-carts for senior pilgrims
schemes.briefHindi: तीर्थस्थलों पर वरिष्ठ नागरिकों व तीर्थयात्रियों हेतु मुफ्त ई-कार्ट, स्वच्छ पेयजल व विश्राम गृह
schemes.benefit: Integrated development of pilgrimage sites providing battery-operated carts for elderly and disabled pilgrims, clean rest houses, and tourist facilitation centers
schemes.benefitHindi: वरिष्ठ व दिव्यांग तीर्थयात्रियों हेतु बैटरी चालित निःशुल्क गाड़ियां, शेल्टर और सुगम मार्ग
documents: No documents required — open to all public
apply_mode: Public facilities directly available at designated pilgrimage shrines across India
schemes.description: Holistic infrastructure enhancement at revered pilgrimage destinations facilitating safe and comfortable pilgrimage.

schemes.name: Sagarmala Coastal Community Development
schemes.department: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
schemes.brief: Free maritime, fisheries, and logistics skill training with placement for coastal youth
schemes.briefHindi: तटीय क्षेत्रों के युवाओं को बंदरगाह, लॉजिस्टिक्स व समुद्री व्यापार में 100% मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Free job-linked vocational training in port operations, maritime seafaring, and cold-chain aquaculture logistics, with placement assurance in maritime companies
schemes.benefitHindi: समुद्र तटीय युवाओं को उच्च वेतन वाली नौकरियों हेतु मरीन व लॉजिस्टिक्स ट्रेनिंग व प्लेसमेंट
schemes.description: Skill development and economic upliftment initiative specifically designed for coastal fishing communities.

schemes.name: PM MITRA Mega Textile Parks Scheme
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम मित्र मेगा टेक्सटाइल पार्क योजना
schemes.brief: Subsidized factory space, power and training for handloom weavers and textile startups
schemes.briefHindi: बुनकरों व कपड़ा उद्यमियों को विश्वस्तरीय कार्यशालाएं, सस्ती बिजली और प्रशिक्षण सहायता
schemes.benefit: Plug-and-play modern industrial sheds, zero electricity duty for 5 years, subsidized capital credit for textile machinery, creating 1 lakh jobs per park
schemes.benefitHindi: कपड़ा व हथकरघा इकाइयों हेतु रेडी-टू-यूज शेड, सस्ती बिजली और मशीनरी पर ऋण सहायता
schemes.description: Creates state-of-the-art integrated textile parks providing world-class infrastructure to handloom weavers and apparel makers.

schemes.name: Krishi UDAN 2.0 Scheme
schemes.brief: Subsidized air freight and airport logistics for agri-produce from hilly, NE, and rural regions
schemes.briefHindi: पहाड़ी, पूर्वोत्तर और ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों से कृषि उपज के लिए रियायती हवाई माल ढुलाई
schemes.benefit: 50% freight subsidy and zero airport storage charges on air transportation of agri-perishables for FPOs and farmers
schemes.benefitHindi: एफपीओ और किसानों के लिए कृषि उपज के हवाई परिवहन पर 50% माल ढुलाई सब्सिडी
apply_mode: Online at e-KUSUM / Krishi UDAN Portal
schemes.description: Incentivizes the movement of agri-produce by air transportation to help farmers access distant domestic and global markets.

schemes.name: GOBARdhan Scheme (Bio-Gas & Bio-Slurry)
schemes.brief: Financial assistance up to ₹50 Lakh per district for community biogas and compressed biogas (CBG) plants
schemes.briefHindi: सामुदायिक बायोगैस और सीबीजी संयंत्रों के लिए प्रति जिला ₹50 लाख तक वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: Capital support up to ₹50 Lakh for setting up community/commercial bio-gas plants converting cattle dung & organic waste into energy
schemes.benefitHindi: गोबर और जैविक कचरे से ऊर्जा संयंत्र लगाने के लिए ₹50 लाख तक का वित्तीय सहयोग
schemes.description: Converts animal dung, agri-residues, and organic waste into bio-gas, enriched slurry, and bio-CNG to empower rural households.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.brief: 3% interest subvention and credit guarantee on medium-to-long term loans up to ₹2 Crore for farm post-harvest infra
schemes.briefHindi: खेत स्तर पर गोदाम, कोल्ड स्टोरेज व प्रसंस्करण के लिए ₹2 करोड़ तक के ऋण पर 3% ब्याज छूट
schemes.benefit: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 Cr for up to 7 years + CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage fee paid by Govt
schemes.benefitHindi: 7 वर्षों के लिए ₹2 करोड़ तक के ऋण पर 3% ब्याज छूट + सरकार द्वारा क्रेडिट गारंटी
schemes.description: Financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.

schemes.name: PM-PRANAM (Alternative Fertilizers Scheme)
schemes.brief: Financial grants to states and farmers for reducing chemical fertilizers and adopting nano-urea and bio-inputs
schemes.briefHindi: रासायनिक खाद की खपत घटाने और नैनो यूरिया व जैविक इनपुट अपनाने पर वित्तीय प्रोत्साहन
schemes.benefit: 50% fertilizer subsidy savings refunded as direct community development grants + subsidized nano-urea / bio-fertilizer kits
schemes.benefitHindi: उर्वरक सब्सिडी बचत का 50% विकास अनुदान के रूप में + रियायती नैनो यूरिया किट
schemes.description: Incentivizes states and farmers to promote balanced fertilizer use and alternate bio-fertilizers.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samriddhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.brief: ₹6,000 Cr central sector scheme providing micro-grants, aquaculture insurance, and supply-chain subsidies for fishers
schemes.briefHindi: मछुआरों और जलीय कृषि किसानों को माइक्रो-ग्रांट, फसल बीमा और मूल्य श्रृंखला सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: One-time micro-grant up to ₹40,000 for fish seed/feed, 40-60% subsidy on cold chain vans, and subsidized group insurance
schemes.benefitHindi: मत्स्य बीज व आहार के लिए ₹40,000 तक अनुदान और कोल्ड चेन वाहनों पर 40-60% सब्सिडी
schemes.description: Central scheme to formalize the unorganized fisheries sector and assist micro and small fish farming enterprises.

schemes.name: PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम आयुष्मान भारत स्वास्थ्य अवसंरचना मिशन
schemes.brief: Establishes critical care hospital blocks, integrated public health labs, and free diagnostic tests in every district
schemes.briefHindi: हर जिले में क्रिटिकल केयर ब्लॉक, एकीकृत लैब और मुफ्त नैदानिक परीक्षण सुविधाएं
schemes.benefit: Access to 134 free diagnostic tests, critical care hospitalizations, and specialized intensive care in district hospitals
schemes.benefitHindi: जिला अस्पतालों में 134 मुफ्त जांचें, आपातकालीन क्रिटिकल केयर और आईसीयू सुविधाएं
documents: ABHA Health ID (Ayushman Bharat Health Account)
schemes.description: Strengthens healthcare infrastructure from village Ayushman Arogya Mandirs to district-level critical care hospital blocks.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme
schemes.brief: 100% free hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis sessions for BPL patients in all district hospitals
schemes.briefHindi: बीपीएल परिवारों के गुर्दा रोगियों के लिए सभी जिला अस्पतालों में 100% मुफ्त डायलिसिस
schemes.benefit: Free regular dialysis cycles (saving ₹20,000–₹35,000 per month) + free essential dialysis consumables and testing
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति माह ₹20,000–₹35,000 की बचत — नियमित डायलिसिस व आवश्यक दवाएं पूरी तरह मुफ्त
schemes.description: Provides life-saving renal replacement therapy and free dialysis services to underprivileged kidney patients.

schemes.name: Mission Indradhanush 5.0 (Universal Immunization)
schemes.brief: 100% free immunization against 12 life-threatening vaccine-preventable diseases for children up to 5 years and pregnant mothers
schemes.briefHindi: 5 वर्ष तक के बच्चों और गर्भवती माताओं के लिए 12 घातक बीमारियों के खिलाफ 100% मुफ्त टीकाकरण
schemes.benefit: Free full immunization coverage including Polio, Hepatitis B, Measles-Rubella, Rotavirus, Pneumococcal, DPT, and Tetanus
schemes.benefitHindi: पोलियो, हेपेटाइटिस, खसरा-रूबेला, न्यूमोकोकल सहित 12 टीकों का पूर्ण निःशुल्क सुरक्षा चक्र
documents: Child Birth Certificate or MCP Card
schemes.description: Intensified mission to vaccinate all unvaccinated and partially vaccinated children and pregnant women across India.

schemes.name: National AYUSH Mission & Swasthya Raksha
schemes.nameHindi: राष्ट्रीय आयुष मिशन एवं स्वास्थ्य रक्षा
schemes.brief: Free Ayurvedic, Homeopathic, and Unani preventive healthcare consultations, herbal remedies, and lifestyle therapies
schemes.briefHindi: आयुर्वेदिक, होम्योपैथिक और यूनानी मुफ्त उपचार, जड़ी-बूटियां और जीवनशैली परामर्श
schemes.benefit: Free diagnosis, authentic traditional medicines, and specialized Panchakarma therapies at AYUSH wellness dispensaries
schemes.benefitHindi: आयुष कल्याण केंद्रों पर मुफ्त जांच, प्रामाणिक दवाएं और पंचकर्म उपचार
schemes.description: Expands traditional AYUSH healthcare delivery and provides accessible natural and preventive medicines.

schemes.name: PM SHRI Schools Scheme
schemes.brief: Upgraded national model schools with cutting-edge smart labs, coding curriculum, green school tech, and NEP pedagogy
schemes.briefHindi: स्मार्ट लैब, कोडिंग पाठ्यक्रम और आधुनिक सुविधाओं से लैस राष्ट्रीय आदर्श विद्यालय
schemes.benefit: Free world-class schooling, modern AI and robotics labs, interactive digital boards, sports facilities, and free study kits
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त विश्वस्तरीय स्कूली शिक्षा, रोबोटिक्स लैब, डिजिटल बोर्ड, खेल सुविधाएं व निःशुल्क किट
schemes.description: Transforms 14,500+ government schools into exemplary institutions showcasing the National Education Policy 2020.

schemes.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
schemes.brief: ₹50,000/year scholarship for specially-abled students (40%+ disability) pursuing technical degrees or diplomas
schemes.briefHindi: तकनीकी शिक्षा प्राप्त कर रहे 40%+ दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों को ₹50,000 प्रति वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per year towards college fees, assistive devices, accessible software, and learning aids
schemes.benefitHindi: कॉलेज फीस, सहायक उपकरण और अध्ययन सामग्री हेतु ₹50,000 प्रति वर्ष
schemes.description: Supports differently-abled students with financial scholarships to pursue professional and technical courses.

schemes.name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS for Higher Education)
schemes.nameHindi: केंद्रीय क्षेत्र ब्याज सब्सिडी योजना (उच्च शिक्षा ऋण)
schemes.brief: 100% interest waiver on education loans taken for professional/technical courses during course + 1 year moratorium
schemes.briefHindi: पाठ्यक्रम अवधि + 1 वर्ष अधिस्थगन के दौरान व्यावसायिक शिक्षा ऋण पर 100% ब्याज की पूरी माफी
schemes.benefit: Complete waiver of bank loan interest during study duration and moratorium (saving ₹1.5L to ₹4L on higher education loans)
schemes.benefitHindi: अध्ययन के दौरान बैंक ऋण ब्याज की 100% छूट — ₹1.5 लाख से ₹4 लाख तक की सीधी बचत
schemes.description: Reimburses full interest accrued on educational loans taken from scheduled banks for economically weaker section students.

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST & Traditional Artisans
schemes.nameHindi: राष्ट्रीय प्रवासी छात्रवृत्ति (विदेश में उच्च अध्ययन)
schemes.brief: Full tuition fees, airfare, and annual living allowance (approx ₹15 Lakh/yr) for Masters & Ph.D. degrees in top global universities
schemes.briefHindi: शीर्ष वैश्विक विश्वविद्यालयों में मास्टर्स और पीएचडी के लिए पूरी ट्यूशन फीस, हवाई किराया व निर्वाह भत्ता
schemes.benefit: 100% financial coverage for tuition, medical insurance, books, and living allowance (~$15,400 / £9,900 per year) abroad
schemes.benefitHindi: विदेश में पढ़ाई हेतु 100% ट्यूशन फीस, वीजा, हवाई टिकट और प्रति वर्ष ~$15,400 निर्वाह भत्ता
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to selected meritorious SC, ST, and nomadic community students for pursuing Masters and PhD abroad.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
schemes.brief: Free industry-aligned training in cutting-edge tech (AI, Drone piloting, 3D printing, Solar, Robotics) with stipend & placement
schemes.briefHindi: एआई, ड्रोन, 3डी प्रिंटिंग व रोबोटिक्स में निःशुल्क उद्योग-संरेखित प्रशिक्षण, वजीफा और नौकरी
schemes.benefit: 100% free certified vocational training, ₹500/day travel/stipend allowance during training, Skill India certificate, and job placement assistance
schemes.benefitHindi: पूरी तरह मुफ्त प्रमाणित प्रशिक्षण, दैनिक वजीफा, स्किल इंडिया प्रमाणपत्र और रोजगार सहायता
schemes.description: Equips Indian youth with on-demand future skills, drone technology, green hydrogen, and digital fabrication.

schemes.name: Vidyanjali 2.0 Community School Mentorship
schemes.brief: Connects community volunteers and CSR sponsors to donate digital devices, books, and career mentoring to govt school students
schemes.briefHindi: सरकारी स्कूलों के विद्यार्थियों को मुफ्त डिजिटल उपकरण, पुस्तकें और करियर परामर्श से जोड़ना
schemes.benefit: Access to free learning tablets, STEM learning kits, spoken English mentoring, and career coaching by professionals
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त टैबलेट, एसटीईएम किट, अंग्रेजी बोलने का प्रशिक्षण और पेशेवरों द्वारा करियर कोचिंग
schemes.description: Fosters community and private sector involvement in government schools to enhance learning assets and student skills.

schemes.name: Manodarpan Psychosocial Support Initiative
schemes.brief: Free 24x7 toll-free mental wellness, stress counselling, and exam anxiety guidance for students, teachers, and parents
schemes.briefHindi: विद्यार्थियों और अभिभावकों के लिए परीक्षा तनाव और मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेतु 24x7 मुफ्त परामर्श
schemes.benefit: Zero-cost confidential telephone & chat counseling by certified psychologists (Toll-free 844-844-0632) + interactive webinars
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रमाणित मनोवैज्ञानिकों द्वारा 24x7 मुफ्त व गोपनीय परामर्श (टोल-फ्री 844-844-0632)
schemes.description: National initiative providing psychosocial support to students for their mental health and emotional well-being.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman
schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.brief: ₹15,000 toolkit voucher + collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% concessional interest + ₹500/day training stipend
schemes.briefHindi: कारीगरों को ₹15,000 टूलकिट वाउचर, ₹3 लाख तक का 5% ब्याज पर ऋण और ₹500/दिन वजीफा
schemes.benefit: Free PM Vishwakarma ID card, ₹15,000 digital toolkit grant, ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1) + ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2) loans at 5% fixed interest
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त विश्वकर्मा आईडी, ₹15,000 टूलकिट अनुदान, ₹3 लाख तक का 5% रियायती ब्याज पर ऋण
documents: Proof of Traditional Trade (18 identified trades)
schemes.description: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople covering 18 trades with training, toolkit, and cheap credit.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.nameHindi: सूक्ष्म एवं लघु उद्यम क्रेडिट गारंटी फंड ट्रस्ट
schemes.brief: Collateral-free bank loans up to ₹5 Crore for new and existing micro and small enterprises with 75-85% govt credit guarantee
schemes.briefHindi: बिना किसी गिरवी/जमानत के सूक्ष्म व लघु उद्योगों के लिए ₹5 करोड़ तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त बैंक ऋण
schemes.benefit: Entrepreneurs can avail term loans & working capital up to ₹5 Cr without pledging land or property; 85% guarantee coverage for women/SC/ST
schemes.benefitHindi: बिना जमीन/प्रॉपर्टी गिरवी रखे ₹5 करोड़ तक का बिजनेस लोन; महिलाओं व एससी/एसटी हेतु 85% गारंटी
schemes.description: Enables micro and small enterprises to access collateral-free institutional credit with government backed credit guarantees.

schemes.name: RAMP Scheme (Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance)
schemes.brief: Grants and technical assistance for MSMEs to adopt clean green technology, resolve delayed payments, and scale exports
schemes.briefHindi: एमएसएमई को हरित तकनीक अपनाने, विलंबित भुगतान समाधान और निर्यात बढ़ाने हेतु अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹5 Lakh grant for green tech adoption, zero-defect manufacturing certification, and access to Trade Receivables (TReDS)
schemes.benefitHindi: हरित प्रौद्योगिकी और जीरो-डिफेक्ट निर्माण प्रमाणन हेतु ₹5 लाख तक का अनुदान
schemes.description: World Bank supported national program to strengthen MSME capacity, technology adoption, and market access.

schemes.name: PM Mudra Yojana — Tarun Plus (₹20 Lakh Limit)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम मुद्रा योजना — तरुण प्लस (₹20 लाख ऋण सीमा)
schemes.brief: Enhanced Mudra loan limit up to ₹20 Lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous Tarun loans
schemes.briefHindi: सफल उद्यमियों के लिए विस्तारित मुद्रा ऋण सीमा ₹20 लाख तक — बिना संपार्श्विक
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free working capital and asset purchase loan from ₹10 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh with credit guarantee under CGFMU
schemes.benefitHindi: बिना गारंटी ₹10 लाख से ₹20 लाख तक का बिजनेस विस्तार ऋण
schemes.description: Expanded category under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana offering loans up to ₹20 lakh for growing micro enterprises.

schemes.name: One District One Product (ODOP) Export Promotion
schemes.nameHindi: एक जिला एक उत्पाद (ओडीओपी) निर्यात संवर्धन
schemes.brief: Financial subsidies, international packaging upgrades, and GeM onboarding for distinctive district-specialty products
schemes.briefHindi: जिले के विशिष्ट उत्पादों की पैकेजिंग, ब्रांडिंग, निर्यात और सरकारी ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पर मुफ्त लिस्टिंग
schemes.benefit: 50% freight and exhibition stall subsidy + free GeM portal seller account + customized barcode and GI tagging assistance
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रदर्शनी व माल ढुलाई पर 50% सब्सिडी + GeM पोर्टल पर मुफ्त विक्रेता खाता व जीआई टैग सहायता
schemes.description: Identifies, promotes, and brands one unique product from each of the 750+ districts in India to foster local manufacturing.

schemes.name: ASPIRE Scheme for Rural Agro-Enterprise Incubation
schemes.brief: Up to ₹1 Crore grant for setting up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators in rural districts
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में आजीविका बिजनेस इनक्यूबेटर स्थापित करने हेतु ₹1 करोड़ तक का अनुदान
schemes.benefit: 100% financial assistance up to ₹100 Lakh for machinery and seed capital to train rural youth into agro-business entrepreneurs
schemes.benefitHindi: मशीनरी और सीड कैपिटल हेतु ₹100 लाख तक की 100% वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.description: Promotes innovation, entrepreneurship, and agro-industry incubation in rural areas.

schemes.name: SFURTI (Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries)
schemes.brief: Financial grant up to ₹5 Crore per artisan cluster for common facility centers, modern machinery, and direct marketing
schemes.briefHindi: पारंपरिक कारीगर क्लस्टरों के लिए कॉमन फैसिलिटी सेंटर व आधुनिक मशीनों हेतु ₹5 करोड़ तक अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹2.5 Cr (regular cluster of 500 artisans) or ₹5 Cr (major cluster) for infrastructure, raw material banks, and global design input
schemes.benefitHindi: 500+ कारीगरों के क्लस्टर हेतु ₹2.5 से ₹5 करोड़ तक का प्रत्यक्ष ढांचागत अनुदान
schemes.description: Organizes traditional artisans and crafts into competitive clusters with world-class common production facilities.

schemes.name: Mission Shakti (Sambal & Samarthya)
schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.brief: Integrated umbrella scheme providing emergency safety helplines, shelter homes, crèches for working mothers, and legal aid
schemes.briefHindi: महिलाओं की सुरक्षा, कानूनी सहायता, अल्पकालिक आवास और कामकाजी माताओं के बच्चों के लिए पालना गृह
schemes.benefit: Free residential stay at Shakti Sadan, free legal representation, 24x7 181 Women Helpline, and subsidized crèche facilities (Palna)
schemes.benefitHindi: शक्ति सदन में मुफ्त आवास, मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता, 181 हेल्पलाइन और शिशु पालना गृह
apply_mode: One Stop Center (OSC) in every district
schemes.description: Umbrella scheme for safety, security, and empowerment of women across life stages.

schemes.name: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0
schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.brief: Fortified supplementary nutrition, growth tracking, and early childhood education across 14 lakh upgraded Anganwadis
schemes.briefHindi: 14 लाख सक्षम आंगनवाड़ियों में पौष्टिक आहार, कुपोषण निवारण और प्रारंभिक बाल शिक्षा
schemes.benefit: Free daily hot cooked meals and take-home nutrient rations (THR) for children under 6, pregnant women, and lactating mothers
schemes.benefitHindi: 6 वर्ष तक के बच्चों और गर्भवती/धात्री माताओं को मुफ्त गर्म पौष्टिक भोजन व टेक-होम राशन
schemes.description: National flagship initiative to address malnutrition among children, adolescent girls, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.

schemes.name: Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC) Scheme
schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.brief: Single-window 24x7 emergency medical aid, police assistance, psycho-social counselling, and temporary shelter for women in distress
schemes.briefHindi: संकटग्रस्त महिलाओं को एक ही छत के नीचे 24x7 मुफ्त चिकित्सा, पुलिस सहायता, काउंसलिंग व 5 दिन का आवास
schemes.benefit: Free immediate medical care, FIR filing support, legal advocacy, mental health counselling, and up to 5 days safe temporary shelter
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त चिकित्सा उपचार, एफआईआर सहायता, कानूनी वकील, काउंसलिंग और सुरक्षित अस्थायी आवास
apply_mode: District One Stop Centre (adjacent to district hospitals)
schemes.description: Provides integrated support and assistance under one roof to women affected by violence in private and public spaces.

schemes.name: PM-DAKSH Skill Development Scheme
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.brief: Free high-quality skill training with ₹1,000 to ₹1,500/month stipend and wage-employment placement for SC, OBC, and Sanitation Workers
schemes.briefHindi: एससी, ओबीसी और सफाई कर्मचारियों को निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण, ₹1,500/माह वजीफा और रोजगार
schemes.benefit: Free training across 45+ trades, ₹1,500 monthly stipend during training, free uniform & study material, and government certification
schemes.benefitHindi: 45+ ट्रेडों में मुफ्त प्रशिक्षण, ₹1,500 मासिक वजीफा, मुफ्त यूनिफॉर्म और सरकारी प्रमाणपत्र
schemes.description: National action plan for skilling marginalized target groups including SCs, OBCs, EWS, and Safai Karamcharis.

schemes.name: SHRESHTHA Scheme for Quality Residential Education
schemes.nameHindi: श्रेष्ठ योजना (मेधावी एससी छात्रों हेतु आवासीय शिक्षा)
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.brief: 100% free education in top private CBSE residential schools from Class 9 to 12 for meritorious Scheduled Caste students
schemes.briefHindi: मेधावी एससी छात्रों को कक्षा 9 से 12 तक शीर्ष निजी आवासीय सीबीएसई स्कूलों में 100% मुफ्त शिक्षा
schemes.benefit: Govt bears full school fees, boarding, lodging, uniforms, books, and computer lab expenses up to ₹1.35 Lakh per year per student
schemes.benefitHindi: स्कूल फीस, हॉस्टल, भोजन, पुस्तकें व यूनिफॉर्म का ₹1.35 लाख/वर्ष तक का पूरा खर्च सरकार द्वारा
schemes.description: Provides seats in the best private residential schools in the country to meritorious SC boys and girls through a national entrance test.

schemes.name: PM-JANMAN (Tribal PVTG Holistic Development)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम-जनमन (विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूह महाभियान)
schemes.brief: ₹24,000 Crore mega-mission providing pucca housing, piped clean water, all-weather roads, and solar electricity for 75 PVTG tribes
schemes.briefHindi: 75 विशेष रूप से कमजोर जनजातीय समूहों (PVTG) के लिए पक्का मकान, पाइप से जल, सड़क और सौर बिजली
schemes.benefit: ₹2.39 Lakh pucca house grant + ₹12,000 toilet grant + free standalone off-grid solar home systems + mobile health vans
schemes.benefitHindi: पक्के घर हेतु ₹2.39 लाख + शौचालय हेतु ₹12,000 + मुफ्त सौर घरेलू बिजली संयंत्र
schemes.description: Saturation drive to provide critical infrastructure, clean drinking water, electricity, and livelihood to 75 PVTG communities.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Component A & C (Agri-Solar Feeder & Pumps)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम-कुसुम कंपोनेंट ए एवं सी (कृषि सोलर फीडर)
schemes.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.brief: Solarization of agricultural water pumps and installation of small 500kW to 2MW solar power plants on barren farmer lands
schemes.briefHindi: खेतों के सिंचाई पंपों का सौरकरण और बंजर भूमि पर सोलर प्लांट लगाकर बिजली बेचकर आमदनी
schemes.benefit: 60% combined subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on solar pump cost + earn ₹25,000–₹60,000/year per acre by selling excess green power
schemes.benefitHindi: सोलर पंप पर 60% सब्सिडी + अतिरिक्त सौर ऊर्जा बिजली ग्रिड को बेचकर नियमित वार्षिक आय
apply_mode: State Renewable Energy Development Agency (HAREDA, UPNEDA, etc.)
schemes.description: De-dieselizes the agricultural sector by providing subsidized solar water pumps and enabling farmers to sell excess power.

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase 2
schemes.brief: ₹12,000 cash incentive for individual household latrine construction + solid & liquid waste management in ODF Plus villages
schemes.briefHindi: व्यक्तिगत घरेलू शौचालय निर्माण हेतु ₹12,000 नकद प्रोत्साहन और ठोस-तरल कचरा प्रबंधन
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 direct DBT into bank account upon constructing twin-pit pour-flush toilet + community sanitary complex access
schemes.benefitHindi: शौचालय निर्माण पर ₹12,000 का प्रत्यक्ष बैंक अंतरण (डीबीटी)
schemes.description: Sustains open defecation free status of villages and ensures visual cleanliness and hygiene across rural India.

schemes.name: Mission Amrit Sarovar (Water Conservation)
schemes.brief: Development and rejuvenation of at least 75 Amrit Sarovars (water bodies) in each district of India with MGNREGS wage work
schemes.briefHindi: प्रत्येक जिले में कम से कम 75 विशाल अमृत सरोवरों का निर्माण व जीर्णोद्धार
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed 100 days of rural wage employment under MGNREGA + permanent groundwater recharge and subsidized fisheries lease for locals
schemes.benefitHindi: मनरेगा के तहत मजदूरी रोजगार + स्थानीय ग्रामीणों हेतु मत्स्य पालन व सिंचाई जल उपलब्धता
schemes.description: Constructs and rejuvenates community water bodies to fight climate change and boost rural livelihoods.

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission — Har Ghar Jal
schemes.nameHindi: जल जीवन मिशन — हर घर जल
schemes.brief: Functional household tap connection (FHTC) providing 55 liters per capita per day of potable quality drinking water
schemes.briefHindi: प्रत्येक ग्रामीण घर को पाइप द्वारा 55 लीटर प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन शुद्ध नल जल
schemes.benefit: Zero capital cost piped tap water connection delivered directly inside household premises + regular water quality testing
schemes.benefitHindi: शून्य लागत पर घर के अंदर नल कनेक्शन + शुद्ध व सुरक्षित पेयजल की नियमित जांच
schemes.description: Ensures every rural household in India has access to safe and adequate drinking water through an individual household tap connection.

schemes.name: National Bioenergy Programme (Waste-to-Energy)
schemes.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.brief: Capital CFA subsidies up to ₹5 Crore for setting up biomass pellet, briquette, and biogas power generation plants
schemes.briefHindi: पराली व बायोमास से पेलेट व बायो-सीएनजी संयंत्र लगाने पर ₹5 करोड़ तक केंद्रीय वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: Central Financial Assistance of ₹9 Lakh per TPH (up to ₹45 Lakh) for biomass pellet plants and up to ₹5 Cr for urban waste-to-energy
schemes.benefitHindi: बायोमास पेलेट प्लांट पर ₹45 लाख तक और वेस्ट-टू-एनर्जी संयंत्रों पर ₹5 करोड़ तक की सब्सिडी
schemes.description: Utilizes agricultural residues, agro-industrial waste, and urban biomass to generate green electricity and compressed bio-gas.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin Plus (Solar & Fuel Pack)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम आवास योजना - ग्रामीण प्लस (सौर व स्वच्छ ईंधन)
schemes.brief: ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh house building grant + 90 days MGNREGA wages + free Ujjwala gas and solar home unit
schemes.briefHindi: पक्के घर हेतु ₹1.30 लाख + 90 दिन की मनरेगा मजदूरी + मुफ्त उज्ज्वला गैस व सोलर रूफटॉप
schemes.benefit: Total combined assistance exceeding ₹1.65 Lakh: direct cash for house construction + ₹27,000 unskilled labour wages + free toilet & LPG
schemes.benefitHindi: कुल ₹1.65 लाख से अधिक की सहायता — पक्का घर, मजदूरी, शौचालय और गैस कनेक्शन
schemes.description: Comprehensive rural housing scheme providing financial assistance to houseless and kutcha house residents to construct durable pucca homes.

schemes.name: e-Shram National Database & Welfare Linkage
schemes.brief: Universal 12-digit UAN card with free ₹2 Lakh accidental death/permanent disability cover and direct access to central social security
schemes.briefHindi: असंगठित श्रमिकों हेतु 12 अंकों का यूएएन कार्ड, ₹2 लाख का मुफ्त दुर्घटना बीमा और योजनाओं से जुड़ाव
schemes.benefit: Free accidental insurance of ₹2,00,000 on death / full disability and ₹1,00,000 on partial disability via PMSBY + DBT portability
schemes.benefitHindi: दुर्घटना मृत्यु पर ₹2 लाख और आंशिक विकलांगता पर ₹1 लाख का मुफ्त बीमा कवर
schemes.description: National database of unorganized workers providing universal identification and automatic seeding into social security benefits.

schemes.name: Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY)
schemes.brief: Government pays entire 24% EPF contribution (12% employee + 12% employer) for new formal sector hires earning < ₹15,000/mo
schemes.briefHindi: औपचारिक क्षेत्र के नए कर्मचारियों का पूरा 24% पीएफ अंशदान 2 साल तक सरकार वहन करती है
schemes.benefit: Zero deduction from salary for employee PF share + employer saves 12% cost, boosting take-home pay and guaranteed pension rights
schemes.benefitHindi: वेतन से बिना कटौती के पूरा पीएफ लाभ — कर्मचारी की टेक-होम सैलरी में सीधी बढ़ोतरी
schemes.description: Incentivizes employers to create new formal jobs by reimbursing both employee and employer EPF contributions for up to two years.

schemes.name: Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme (EDLI)
schemes.brief: Free life insurance cover up to ₹7 Lakh for all active members of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPFO) payable to nominee
schemes.briefHindi: ईपीएफओ के सभी सक्रिय सदस्यों के लिए ₹7 लाख तक का मुफ्त जीवन बीमा कवर
schemes.benefit: Nominee receives a lump sum payout of up to ₹7,00,000 (minimum ₹2.5 Lakh) upon unfortunate demise of worker during service
schemes.benefitHindi: सेवाकाल में मृत्यु होने पर आश्रित परिजनों को ₹2.5 लाख से ₹7 लाख तक का एकमुश्त बीमा भुगतान
schemes.description: Provides assurance benefit and lump-sum financial protection to nominees of private and organized sector employees in case of death.

schemes.name: PM Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
schemes.brief: Free 20-hour practical computer, smartphone, internet, and UPI digital payments training for one person per rural household
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण परिवारों के लिए मुफ्त 20 घंटे का कंप्यूटर, स्मार्टफोन, इंटरनेट व यूपीआई डिजिटल भुगतान प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Zero-cost 10-20 days training module, hands-on practice on computers and smartphones, and accredited NIELIT/CSC digital literacy certificate
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त प्रशिक्षण, कंप्यूटर व स्मार्टफोन अभ्यास और सरकारी डिजिटल साक्षरता प्रमाणपत्र
documents: Ration Card (to verify rural household eligibility)
schemes.description: Makes rural citizens digitally literate so they can access government services, perform digital payments, and use online tools.

schemes.name: Digital India Bhashini Language Mission
schemes.brief: Voice and AI-based vernacular translation ecosystem enabling citizens to access welfare services in 22 Indian regional languages
schemes.briefHindi: 22 भारतीय भाषाओं में आवाज और एआई द्वारा सरकारी सेवाओं और योजनाओं तक आसान पहुंच
schemes.benefit: Access all government portals, chat, and voice helplines in native mother tongue (Hindi, Punjabi, Haryanvi, Bengali, etc.) with real-time translation
schemes.benefitHindi: अपनी मातृभाषा में सरकारी योजनाओं की जानकारी और वॉयस आधारित सहायता
schemes.description: National AI language technology platform breaking language barriers and ensuring digital inclusivity for every Indian.

schemes.name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
schemes.department: Department of Women & Child Development, Delhi
schemes.brief: Staggered financial grant up to ₹36,000 deposited in SBI life savings for girl children born and studying in Delhi
schemes.briefHindi: दिल्ली में जन्मी और पढ़ने वाली बेटियों को ₹36,000 तक की संचयी वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance deposited at birth (₹11,000) and at admission into Classes 1, 6, 9, 10, and 12 (₹5,000 each) — matures with interest at age 18
schemes.benefitHindi: जन्म पर ₹11,000 व विभिन्न कक्षाओं में प्रवेश पर ₹5,000 की किस्तें — 18 वर्ष पर ब्याज सहित परिपक्वता
documents: Proof of 3-year Delhi Residence (Voter ID/Ration Card)
schemes.description: Promotes birth registration and high school education of girl children in Delhi while discouraging female foeticide.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Jai Bhim Pratibha Vikas Yojana
schemes.nameHindi: मुख्यमंत्री जय भीम प्रतिभा विकास योजना
schemes.department: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Delhi
schemes.brief: 100% free coaching for UPSC, NEET, JEE, CLAT, and Banking exams in premier institutes + ₹2,500/month stipend
schemes.briefHindi: यूपीएससी, नीट, जेईई, क्लैट की शीर्ष संस्थानों में 100% मुफ्त कोचिंग और ₹2,500 प्रति माह वजीफा
schemes.benefit: Government pays entire coaching fees up to ₹1.5 Lakh directly to empanelled institute + provides ₹2,500/month monthly travel & book allowance
schemes.benefitHindi: कोचिंग फीस (₹1.5 लाख तक) की पूरी प्रतिपूर्ति + ₹2,500/माह मासिक निर्वाह भत्ता
schemes.description: Enables bright SC, ST, OBC, and EWS students from Delhi to clear competitive entrance examinations through free premier coaching.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Teerth Yatra Yojana
schemes.department: Tirth Yatra Vikas Samiti, GNCTD Delhi
schemes.brief: Completely free AC train pilgrimage tours to holy shrines (Ayodhya, Rameswaram, Vaishno Devi, Dwarka, Haridwar) for senior citizens
schemes.briefHindi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए अयोध्या, रामेश्वरम, वैष्णो देवी आदि तीर्थ स्थलों की 100% मुफ्त एसी यात्रा
schemes.benefit: 100% expenses covered: AC III-tier train travel, AC accommodation, pure vegetarian food, local bus sightseeing, and free travel attendant (for 70+)
schemes.benefitHindi: एसी ट्रेन, होटल आवास, भोजन, स्थानीय बस दर्शन और 70+ आयु पर एक सहायक की मुफ्त सुविधा
documents: Medical Fitness Certificate by MBBS Doctor
schemes.description: Sponsors all-expense-paid pilgrimage journeys for elderly citizens residing in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

schemes.name: Delhi Pink Saheli Free Bus Travel for Women
schemes.nameHindi: दिल्ली महिला पिंक टिकट मुफ्त बस यात्रा योजना
schemes.brief: 100% free daily travel in all Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC) and cluster orange/electric buses for all female passengers
schemes.briefHindi: दिल्ली की सभी डीटीसी व क्लस्टर बसों में महिलाओं के लिए असीमित 100% मुफ्त यात्रा (गुलाबी पास)
schemes.benefit: Single-journey Pink Tickets issued on board with zero payment; saves ₹1,200–₹2,500 per month for female commuters and students
schemes.benefitHindi: बस में कंडक्टर से सीधे शून्य लागत पर गुलाबी टिकट — प्रति माह ₹1,200 से ₹2,500 की सीधी बचत
documents: None required (Issued on-board to any female passenger)
apply_mode: Instant on-board bus ticket conductor issuance
schemes.description: Encourages women's mobility, workforce participation, and access to education across Delhi through universal free public bus rides.

schemes.name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Solar Power Scheme
schemes.brief: Additional state Generation Based Incentive (GBI) of ₹2.00 to ₹3.00 per unit for 5 years over and above central solar subsidies
schemes.briefHindi: केंद्रीय सब्सिडी के अतिरिक्त दिल्ली सरकार द्वारा 5 वर्षों तक ₹2 से ₹3 प्रति यूनिट का अतिरिक्त उत्पादन प्रोत्साहन
schemes.benefit: Achieve zero electricity bills + receive monthly GBI payouts directly in bank account + 100% waiver on net metering fees
schemes.benefitHindi: शून्य बिजली बिल + मासिक जीबीआई नकद भुगतान सीधे बैंक में + नेट मीटरिंग शुल्क की पूरी छूट
schemes.description: Delhi's landmark solar policy offering generation-based incentives to accelerate domestic solar adoption.

schemes.name: Delhi Financial Assistance to Women in Distress (Widow Pension)
schemes.nameHindi: दिल्ली निराश्रित महिला पेंशन योजना (विधवा पेंशन)
schemes.department: Department of Women & Child Development, Delhi
schemes.brief: Direct monthly pension of ₹2,500/month for widows, divorced, separated, and destitute women residing in Delhi
schemes.briefHindi: दिल्ली में रहने वाली विधवा, तलाकशुदा और निराश्रित महिलाओं को ₹2,500 प्रति माह पेंशन
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed monthly cash pension of ₹2,500 credited directly into bank account via DBT to ensure dignity and self-reliance
schemes.benefitHindi: सम्मानपूर्वक जीवन यापन हेतु ₹2,500 प्रति माह प्रत्यक्ष बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Monthly income support scheme for destitute women, widows, and deserted wives residing in Delhi.

schemes.name: Delhi Construction Workers Welfare Board Assistance
schemes.nameHindi: दिल्ली निर्माण श्रमिक कल्याण बोर्ड सहायता योजनाएं
schemes.department: Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (DBOCWWB)
schemes.brief: Comprehensive welfare package: ₹55,000 daughter marriage grant, ₹35,000 maternity assistance, and ₹10,000 tool allowance
schemes.briefHindi: पंजीकृत निर्माण श्रमिकों को बेटी विवाह पर ₹55,000, प्रसूति पर ₹35,000 और टूलकिट हेतु ₹10,000
schemes.benefit: Daughter marriage assistance ₹55,000, maternity benefit ₹35,000, accidental disability cover ₹1 Lakh, and annual health grant
schemes.benefitHindi: शादी सहायता ₹55,000, प्रसूति सहायता ₹35,000, टूलकिट व दुर्घटना सुरक्षा
documents: Delhi Construction Worker Green Card / Registration
schemes.description: Statutory welfare benefits for registered construction workers and masons in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

schemes.name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Pratibha Yojana
schemes.brief: Merit scholarship of ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 per year for students studying in Classes 9 to 12 scoring 50%+ marks
schemes.briefHindi: कक्षा 9 से 12 के 50%+ अंक लाने वाले विद्यार्थियों को ₹5,000 से ₹10,000 प्रति वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 per year for Classes 9 & 10 (scoring 50-59%) and ₹10,000 per year for students scoring 60%+ in previous annual exam
schemes.description: Annual financial reward and incentive for meritorious students in Delhi government and aided schools.

schemes.name: Delhi Financial Assistance to Persons with Special Needs (Divyang Pension)
schemes.nameHindi: दिल्ली विशेष आवश्यकता वाले व्यक्तियों हेतु वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.brief: Monthly financial pension of ₹2,500/month for persons with 40% or more disability residing in Delhi
schemes.briefHindi: 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले दिल्लीवासियों को ₹2,500 प्रति माह नियमित पेंशन
schemes.benefit: Direct monthly bank transfer of ₹2,500 + free assistive calipers, wheelchairs, hearing aids, and free DTC bus pass
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹2,500 प्रति माह बैंक में + मुफ्त सहायक उपकरण (व्हीलचेयर, श्रवण यंत्र) व मुफ्त डीटीसी बस पास
schemes.description: Direct income security scheme ensuring self-reliance and dignified living for differently-abled citizens in Delhi.

schemes.name: Delhi Mukhyamantri Senior Citizen Pension Scheme
schemes.nameHindi: दिल्ली मुख्यमंत्री वरिष्ठ नागरिक पेंशन योजना
schemes.brief: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 (age 60-69) and ₹2,500 (age 70+) with ₹500 additional top-up for SC/ST seniors
schemes.briefHindi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹2,000 से ₹2,500 प्रति माह पेंशन (एससी/एसटी को ₹500 अतिरिक्त)
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed monthly old-age pension deposited via direct benefit transfer into beneficiary's bank account
schemes.benefitHindi: हर महीने सीधे बैंक खाते में ₹2,000 से ₹2,500 की वृद्धावस्था पेंशन
documents: Age Proof (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / Matriculation)
schemes.description: Old age pension support for elderly individuals belonging to economically weaker sections in Delhi.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Septic Tank Safai Yojana
schemes.brief: 100% free mechanized cleaning of domestic septic tanks in unauthorized colonies and rural villages of Delhi
schemes.briefHindi: दिल्ली की अनधिकृत कॉलोनियों और गांवों में सेप्टिक टैंकों की 100% मुफ्त मशीनीकृत सफाई
schemes.benefit: Free suction truck service at doorstep; prevents manual scavenging and eliminates private tanker charges of ₹2,500–₹4,000
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त सक्शन ट्रक सेवा — निजी टैंकरों के ₹2,500-₹4,000 की पूरी बचत व सुरक्षित मशीनी सफाई
schemes.description: Abolishes hazardous manual cleaning by providing free mechanized septic tank suction services across Delhi.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Parivar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY)
schemes.brief: Comprehensive annual financial assistance of ₹6,000/year for families with verified Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) income < ₹1.80L
schemes.briefHindi: परिवार पहचान पत्र में ₹1.80 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों को ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष सामाजिक सुरक्षा सहायता
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year used to fully sponsor PMJJBY (life), PMSBY (accident), PM-SYM (pension), and PMFBY premiums with cash balance paid to bank
schemes.benefitHindi: जीवन, दुर्घटना, फसल व पेंशन बीमा का पूरा प्रीमियम सरकार द्वारा वहन + शेष राशि सीधे बैंक में
schemes.description: Guarantees comprehensive social security cover and life protection to economically vulnerable families in Haryana.

schemes.name: Haryana Chirayu Ayushman Bharat Scheme
schemes.brief: Expands ₹5 Lakh cashless health cover to families with verified annual income between ₹1.80 Lakh and ₹3.00 Lakh (nominal ₹1,500 contribution)
schemes.briefHindi: ₹1.80 से ₹3.00 लाख वार्षिक आय वाले परिवारों को भी ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा कार्ड
schemes.benefit: Cashless in-patient hospital treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in 1,000+ empanelled government and private hospitals across Haryana & India
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति परिवार ₹5,00,000 प्रति वर्ष का कैशलेस इन-पेशेंट इलाज — निजी व सरकारी अस्पतालों में
schemes.description: State-funded universalization of Ayushman Bharat covering over 38 lakh families in Haryana.

schemes.name: Haryana Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana (BBY)
schemes.brief: Price deficiency compensation paying farmers the exact difference if wholesale market prices fall below government protected base prices
schemes.briefHindi: फल-सब्जियों व बाजरे का बाजार भाव संरक्षित मूल्य से नीचे जाने पर अंतर राशि का सीधा भुगतान
schemes.benefit: Direct cash payout per quintal/acre for vegetables, fruits, and millets (e.g. ₹500–₹1,000/quintal deficit coverage directly into bank account)
schemes.benefitHindi: मंडी में भाव गिरने पर सरकार द्वारा अंतर राशि (भावांतर) का प्रत्यक्ष बैंक अंतरण
schemes.description: Pioneering risk-mitigation scheme guaranteeing base income to horticulture and millet farmers in Haryana against market distress sales.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Antyodaya Parivar Utthan Yojana (MMAPUY)
schemes.brief: Doorstep livelihood enhancement package to elevate household income of families earning < ₹1 Lakh to above ₹1.80 Lakh
schemes.briefHindi: ₹1 लाख से कम आय वाले अत्यंत गरीब परिवारों की आय ₹1.80 लाख से ऊपर ले जाने हेतु स्वरोजगार पैकेज
schemes.benefit: Interest-free / subsidized loans up to ₹3 Lakh for dairy farming, poultry, retail shops, e-rickshaws + 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50,000)
schemes.benefitHindi: डेयरी, ई-रिक्शा, दुकान हेतु ₹3 लाख तक का सस्ता ऋण + ₹50,000 तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी
apply_mode: Antyodaya Utthan Melas at Block Level
schemes.description: Targeted mission identifying the poorest families through Family ID to provide customized skilling, capital loans, and employment.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun / Kanyadan Yojana
schemes.department: Welfare of SC & BC Department, Haryana
schemes.brief: Financial grant up to ₹71,000 on the marriage of daughters belonging to SC, BPL, widow, and sports achiever families
schemes.briefHindi: गरीब और अनुसूचित जाति की बेटियों के विवाह पर ₹71,000 तक का सरकारी शगुन अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Direct cash transfer of ₹71,000 (SC/BPL) or ₹51,000 (backward classes) or ₹41,000 (all general BPL) paid before or on marriage date
schemes.benefitHindi: विवाह से पूर्व ₹71,000 तक का प्रत्यक्ष नकद अनुदान सीधे बैंक खाते में
documents: Daughter Age Proof (18+) & Groom Age Proof (21+)
schemes.description: Financial gift scheme honoring the marriage of daughters from underprivileged and marginalized sections in Haryana.

schemes.name: Haryana Old Age Samman Allowance (₹3,000/Month)
schemes.brief: Automatic pension of ₹3,000 per month (highest state old-age pension in India) made without application via Parivar Pehchan Patra
schemes.briefHindi: भारत में सर्वाधिक ₹3,000 प्रति माह वृद्धावस्था पेंशन — 60 वर्ष पूर्ण होते ही परिवार पहचान पत्र से स्वतः शुरू
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed lifelong monthly pension of ₹3,000 deposited directly into bank account; automatic sanction on turning 60 via PPP data
schemes.benefitHindi: आजीवन ₹3,000 प्रति माह पेंशन — बिना किसी कार्यालय के चक्कर काटे स्वतः बैंक में
schemes.description: Proactive social security initiative that automatically disburses ₹3,000 per month to seniors upon attaining 60 years of age.

schemes.name: Haryana Pashudhan Bima Yojana (Livestock Insurance)
schemes.brief: Comprehensive insurance coverage for cows, buffaloes, bulls, and sheep with 100% free premium for SC farmers (₹100–300 for others)
schemes.briefHindi: दुधारू पशुओं की मृत्यु पर ₹80,000 तक का बीमा कवर — एससी पशुपालकों के लिए 100% मुफ्त
schemes.benefit: Insurance claim payout up to ₹80,000 for cows and ₹85,000 for buffaloes in case of accidental death, disease, or calving complications
schemes.benefitHindi: गाय हेतु ₹80,000 व भैंस हेतु ₹85,000 तक का बीमा क्लेम भुगतान
documents: Ear-tagging of Animal by Govt Veterinary Surgeon
apply_mode: Govt Veterinary Hospital / Dispensary in Haryana
schemes.description: Protects dairy farmers in Haryana from catastrophic economic losses due to unexpected mortality of livestock animals.

schemes.name: Haryana Chhatra Parivahan Suraksha Yojana
schemes.brief: Free dedicated, safe bus transportation service from rural villages to all government colleges for female students
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों की छात्राओं के लिए घर से कॉलेज तक पूरी तरह मुफ्त सुरक्षित बस सेवा
schemes.benefit: Zero fare for female college students on dedicated college-special bus routes with GPS tracking and female security marshals
schemes.benefitHindi: निःशुल्क दैनिक आवागमन — कॉलेज बसों में 100% मुफ्त सफर और जीपीएस सुरक्षा
schemes.description: Ensures zero drop-out of girl students in higher education due to lack of safe and accessible rural transportation.

schemes.name: Haryana Ladli Social Security Allowance
schemes.brief: Monthly financial allowance of ₹3,000/month for families having only girl children (from mother's 45th birthday for 15 years)
schemes.briefHindi: केवल बेटियों वाले परिवारों को माता की 45 वर्ष आयु से ₹3,000 प्रति माह सामाजिक सुरक्षा भत्ता
schemes.benefit: Direct monthly pension of ₹3,000 paid to parents with only daughters up to the age of 60 (subsequently transitioned to old age pension)
schemes.benefitHindi: 15 वर्षों तक ₹3,000 प्रति माह की नियमित वित्तीय सहायता — सीधे बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Financial allowance honoring and financially protecting parents who raise only daughters to combat female foeticide.

schemes.name: Haryana Medhavi Chhatra Pratibha Protsahan Yojana
schemes.nameHindi: हरियाणा मेधावी छात्र प्रतिभा प्रोत्साहन योजना
schemes.department: Welfare of SC & BC Department, Haryana
schemes.brief: Cash incentives up to ₹12,000/year for meritorious SC, BC, and Vimukt Jati students excelling in 10th and 12th Board examinations
schemes.briefHindi: 10वीं और 12वीं बोर्ड में उत्कृष्ट अंक लाने वाले एससी/बीसी छात्रों को ₹12,000 तक नकद प्रोत्साहन
schemes.benefit: One-time annual cash reward of ₹8,000 (Class 10) and up to ₹12,000 (Class 12) for achieving 60%+ marks in Board exams
schemes.benefitHindi: बोर्ड परीक्षा में 60%+ अंक पर ₹8,000 से ₹12,000 का एकमुश्त नकद पुरस्कार
schemes.description: Rewards academic excellence among underprivileged backward class and scheduled caste school students in Haryana.

schemes.name: Haryana Matrushakti Udaymita Yojana
schemes.brief: Soft loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 7% interest subvention for women entrepreneurs starting trade, small manufacturing, or service units
schemes.briefHindi: महिला उद्यमियों को नया व्यवसाय शुरू करने हेतु 7% ब्याज अनुदान पर ₹3 लाख तक का बैंक ऋण
schemes.benefit: Bank credit up to ₹3,00,000 with Haryana Women Development Corporation (HWDC) paying 7% interest rebate for 3 years
schemes.benefitHindi: 3 वर्षों तक 7% ब्याज की पूरी छूट के साथ ₹3 लाख तक का व्यापारिक ऋण
schemes.description: Empowers women in Haryana to become self-reliant business owners and micro-manufacturers.

schemes.name: Haryana Manohar Jyoti Solar Home Lighting Scheme
schemes.nameHindi: हरियाणा मनोहर ज्योति सोलर होम लाइटिंग योजना
schemes.brief: Fixed capital subsidy of ₹15,000 for installing 150-watt solar panel, 80Ah lithium battery, LED tube lights, and ceiling fan in rural homes
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण घरों में 150 वॉट सोलर पैनल, लिथियम बैटरी, एलईडी लाइट व पंखे पर ₹15,000 की निश्चित सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of ₹15,000 on total kit cost of ₹22,500 (beneficiary pays only ₹7,500 for a complete off-grid solar setup with 5-year warranty)
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹22,500 के सोलर किट पर ₹15,000 की सब्सिडी — केवल ₹7,500 में पूरा घरेलू सोलर सेटअप
schemes.description: Provides decentralized off-grid solar power packages with lithium-ion storage to un-electrified and power-deficit rural households.

schemes.name: Haryana Labour Welfare Board Higher Education Grant
schemes.nameHindi: हरियाणा श्रम कल्याण बोर्ड उच्च शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन योजना
schemes.brief: Annual educational scholarships from ₹10,000 to ₹40,000 per year for children of registered industrial and commercial workers
schemes.briefHindi: पंजीकृत औद्योगिक व वाणिज्यिक श्रमिकों के बच्चों को ₹10,000 से ₹40,000 प्रति वर्ष उच्च शिक्षा अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Covers entire college tuition for Engineering, MBBS, MBA, Polytechnic, and degree courses (up to ₹40,000/yr per child)
schemes.benefitHindi: बीटेक, एमबीबीएस, पॉलिटेक्निक व स्नातक पढ़ाई हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹40,000 तक की छात्रवृत्ति
documents: Labour Welfare Board Worker Registration Slip
schemes.description: Financially assists children of industrial factory workers and commercial staff to pursue university degrees and professional courses.

schemes.name: UP Banking Correspondent Sakhi (BC Sakhi) Yojana
schemes.nameHindi: यूपी बैंकिंग कॉरेस्पॉन्डेंट सखी (बीसी सखी) योजना
schemes.brief: Deploys trained rural women SHG members as village bankers providing doorstep cash withdrawal, DBT, and banking with ₹4,000/mo stipend
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण महिलाओं को बैंक सखी बनाकर ₹4,000/माह मानदेय, माइक्रो-एटीएम डिवाइस व प्रति ट्रांजैक्शन कमीशन
schemes.benefit: ₹4,000 per month guaranteed honorarium for 6 months + ₹75,000 soft loan/grant for Micro-ATM device & biometric scanner + recurring transaction commissions
schemes.benefitHindi: 6 महीने तक ₹4,000/माह मानदेय + माइक्रो-एटीएम मशीन हेतु ₹75,000 अनुदान/ऋण + बैंकिंग कमीशन
schemes.description: Transforms rural women into financial entrepreneurs delivering doorstep banking and pension disbursement to 58,000+ gram panchayats in UP.

schemes.name: UP Gopalak Dairy Farm Loan Scheme
schemes.brief: Bank loans up to ₹9 Lakh for purchasing 10-12 high-yield indigenous milk cows/buffaloes with a government grant of ₹1.80 Lakh
schemes.briefHindi: 10-12 दुधारू गाय/भैंस की मिनी डेयरी खोलने हेतु ₹9 लाख तक का बैंक ऋण और ₹1.80 लाख का सरकारी अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Bank loan up to ₹9 Lakh with state government giving ₹1,80,000 total subsidy (paid as ₹40,000/year for 5 years directly towards interest)
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹9 लाख तक का बैंक ऋण + ₹1,80,000 का सरकारी ब्याज अनुदान (5 वर्षों में)
schemes.description: Encourages unemployed rural youth and small farmers to set up commercial dairy farms with indigenous cow breeds.

schemes.name: UP Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana (₹5 Lakh)
schemes.nameHindi: यूपी मुख्यमंत्री कृषक दुर्घटना कल्याण योजना
schemes.brief: ₹5,00,000 direct accidental death or permanent disability compensation for registered landholding farmers and battai/sharecroppers
schemes.briefHindi: किसान अथवा बटाईदार की दुर्घटना में मृत्यु या स्थायी दिव्यांगता पर आश्रितों को ₹5,00,000 मुआवजा
schemes.benefit: ₹5 Lakh paid directly to legal heir in case of accidental death (lightning, snakebite, farm machinery, road accident) or ₹3.25L for 60%+ disability
schemes.benefitHindi: दुर्घटना मृत्यु पर ₹5 लाख और 60%+ दिव्यांगता पर ₹3.25 लाख का प्रत्यक्ष सरकारी मुआवजा
schemes.description: Comprehensive accidental safety net covering all farmers, agricultural laborers, and sharecroppers across Uttar Pradesh.

schemes.name: UP Bal Shramik Vidya Yojana
schemes.brief: Direct monthly stipend of ₹1,000 (boys) and ₹1,200 (girls) plus ₹6,000 incentive on passing Class 8, 9, and 10 for rescued child laborers
schemes.briefHindi: बाल श्रम से मुक्त कराए गए बालकों को ₹1,000/माह व बालिकाओं को ₹1,200/माह छात्रवृत्ति + कक्षा 8-10 पास पर ₹6,000
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000/year (boys) and ₹14,400/year (girls) deposited into student's bank account + additional ₹6,000 cash reward on passing Classes 8, 9, 10
schemes.benefitHindi: लड़कों को ₹1,000/माह, लड़कियों को ₹1,200/माह + कक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने पर ₹6,000 का अतिरिक्त प्रोत्साहन
schemes.description: Rehabilitates children rescued from hazardous work and labor by ensuring regular financial support conditioned on formal schooling.

schemes.name: UP Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana
schemes.department: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Free 6-day advanced skill training, free modern electric toolkit, and subsidized bank credit up to ₹10 Lakh for traditional artisans
schemes.briefHindi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों को 6 दिवसीय मुफ्त आधुनिक प्रशिक्षण, मुफ्त उन्नत टूलकिट और ₹10 लाख तक का सस्ता बैंक ऋण
schemes.benefit: 100% free professional toolkit (worth ₹10,000–₹15,000) for carpenters, tailors, barbers, blacksmiths, masons + subsidized PMEGP/Mudra loan linkage
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त आधुनिक टूलकिट किट (मूल्य ₹10,000-₹15,000) + 6 दिन का प्रशिक्षण व ₹10 लाख तक ऋण लिंकेज
schemes.description: Revitalizes traditional artisans (barbers, tailors, carpenters, cobblers, goldsmiths) in UP through modern toolkits and credit assistance.

schemes.name: UP Shadi Anudan Yojana (Marriage Grant)
schemes.brief: One-time financial grant of ₹20,000 per daughter (up to 2 daughters per family) for economically weaker families on their marriage
schemes.briefHindi: गरीब परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹20,000 की एकमुश्त सरकारी अनुदान सहायता
schemes.benefit: ₹20,000 direct bank transfer into the applicant parent's bank account ahead of the wedding ceremony to cover basic wedding expenses
schemes.benefitHindi: विवाह के समय ₹20,000 की एकमुश्त सहायता सीधे बैंक खाते में
documents: Daughter Age Proof (18+) & Groom Age Proof (21+)
schemes.description: Financial assistance provided by the UP government to underprivileged parents on the occasion of their daughters' marriage.

schemes.name: Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme (Free Smartphone/Tablet)
schemes.nameHindi: स्वामी विवेकानंद युवा सशक्तीकरण योजना (मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन/टैबलेट)
schemes.department: Department of IT & Electronics, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Completely free branded 5G smartphones and tablets preloaded with competitive exam content, job apps, and e-learning for college youth
schemes.briefHindi: उच्च व व्यावसायिक शिक्षा के छात्र-छात्राओं को 100% मुफ्त ब्रांडेड स्मार्टफोन और टैबलेट
schemes.benefit: Free smartphone/tablet with 3 years warranty, free government study applications, digital libraries, and skill training portals (zero cost to student)
schemes.benefitHindi: शून्य लागत पर उच्च गुणवत्ता का स्मार्टफोन/टैबलेट, ई-लर्निंग सामग्री और रोजगार पोर्टल लिंकेज
documents: Fee Receipt of Current Academic Year
schemes.description: Equips final and pre-final year undergraduate, postgraduate, engineering, and diploma students in UP with modern smart devices.

schemes.name: UP Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (Loans up to ₹25 Lakh)
schemes.department: Department of MSME & Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Bank loans up to ₹25 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹10 Lakh for service units with 25% margin money capital subsidy from state government
schemes.briefHindi: उद्योग लगाने हेतु ₹25 लाख और सेवा क्षेत्र हेतु ₹10 लाख तक का ऋण + 25% सरकारी पूंजीगत सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: 25% government margin money subsidy (up to ₹6.25 Lakh for industry / ₹2.5 Lakh for services) which converts to permanent grant after 2 years of successful running
schemes.benefitHindi: 25% की भारी सरकारी सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹6.25 लाख) — 2 साल सफल संचालन के बाद स्थायी अनुदान
schemes.description: Incentivizes educated unemployed youth in Uttar Pradesh to establish their own micro-manufacturing and service enterprises.

schemes.name: UP Nirashrit Mahila Pension Yojana (Destitute Widow Pension)
schemes.nameHindi: यूपी निराश्रित महिला पेंशन योजना (विधवा पेंशन)
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Monthly cash pension of ₹1,000/month (₹3,000 quarterly) transferred directly to destitute widows residing in Uttar Pradesh
schemes.briefHindi: उत्तर प्रदेश की निराश्रित विधवा महिलाओं को ₹1,000 प्रति माह (त्रैमासिक ₹3,000) प्रत्यक्ष पेंशन
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed lifelong pension of ₹1,000 per month credited directly into bank account via DBT + Ayushman card entitlement
schemes.benefitHindi: आजीवन ₹1,000 प्रति माह की प्रत्यक्ष पेंशन + आयुष्मान भारत कार्ड में स्वतः पात्रता
schemes.description: Direct financial livelihood support scheme for destitute widows and women whose husbands have passed away.

schemes.name: UP Divyangjan Shadi Protsahan Puraskar
schemes.nameHindi: यूपी दिव्यांगजन शादी प्रोत्साहन पुरस्कार योजना
schemes.brief: Cash reward up to ₹35,000 on marriage of persons with disability (₹15,000 for disabled husband, ₹20,000 for disabled wife, ₹35,000 if both disabled)
schemes.briefHindi: दिव्यांग व्यक्तियों के विवाह पर ₹15,000 से ₹35,000 तक का एकमुश्त नकद पुरस्कार
schemes.benefit: Direct cash reward deposited in bank account: ₹15,000 if husband disabled, ₹20,000 if wife disabled, and ₹35,000 if both partners are disabled
schemes.benefitHindi: दिव्यांग पति पर ₹15,000, दिव्यांग पत्नी पर ₹20,000 और दोनों के दिव्यांग होने पर ₹35,000
schemes.description: State monetary incentive promoting social inclusion and mainstream marital integration of differently-abled citizens.

schemes.name: UP Panchayat Sahayak / Data Entry Operator Scheme
schemes.nameHindi: यूपी पंचायत सहायक / कंप्यूटर ऑपरेटर योजना
schemes.brief: Dedicated Gram Sachivalaya office and paid digital operator in all 58,189 gram panchayats of UP to issue certificates and file welfare applications
schemes.briefHindi: सभी 58,189 ग्राम पंचायतों में ग्राम सचिवालय व पंचायत सहायक द्वारा जन्म, आय, निवास प्रमाणपत्र व पेंशन सेवाएं
schemes.benefit: Villagers can access 200+ government services, print caste/income certificates, and register for schemes in their own village with zero travel cost
schemes.benefitHindi: गांव में ही आय, जाति, निवास व खतौनी नकल की डिलीवरी — ब्लॉक जाने की आवश्यकता नहीं
schemes.description: Decentralizes public administration by establishing digital village secretariats across all 58,189 villages in Uttar Pradesh.

schemes.name: UP Solar Rooftop Net Metering & Consumer Subsidy
schemes.nameHindi: यूपी सोलर रूफटॉप नेट मीटरिंग एवं राज्य सब्सिडी
schemes.department: Uttar Pradesh New & Renewable Energy Development Agency (UPNEDA)
schemes.brief: State capital subsidy of ₹15,000 to ₹30,000 on rooftop solar systems added directly on top of central PM Surya Ghar subsidies
schemes.briefHindi: केंद्रीय पीएम सूर्य घर सब्सिडी के अतिरिक्त यूपी सरकार द्वारा ₹15,000 से ₹30,000 तक की राज्य सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Combined state + central subsidy up to ₹1,08,000 for a 3kW residential rooftop system, making domestic solar payback under 3 years
schemes.benefitHindi: केंद्र + राज्य मिलाकर कुल ₹1,08,000 तक की भारी सब्सिडी — बिजली बिल शून्य
schemes.description: State solar initiative providing additional financial grants to domestic electricity consumers in UP installing rooftop solar.

schemes.name: UP Mahila Samarthya Yojana (Women Micro-Enterprises)
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: ₹200 Crore state initiative setting up Women Common Facility Centers (CFCs) in each block for packaging, processing, and sales
schemes.briefHindi: प्रत्येक ब्लॉक में महिला कॉमन फैसिलिटी सेंटर स्थापित कर महिला स्वयं सहायता समूहों को उत्पादन व पैकेजिंग सहायता
schemes.benefit: 90% government funding for setting up block-level women manufacturing units + guaranteed bulk government procurement of products
schemes.benefitHindi: ब्लॉक स्तरीय महिला उत्पादन इकाइयों हेतु 90% सरकारी फंडिंग व सरकारी खरीद में प्राथमिकता
schemes.description: Boosts grassroots women's collective enterprises by creating modern common processing and marketing facilities in every development block.

schemes.name: UP Mukhyamantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
schemes.brief: 40% capital subsidy for excavation of new fish ponds and input grants on village gram sabha leased waterbodies
schemes.briefHindi: ग्राम सभा के पट्टे वाले तालाबों पर नए मत्स्य पालन व तालाब खुदाई हेतु 40% पूंजीगत सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy of ₹1.60 Lakh per hectare for pond construction + ₹80,000 input subsidy for fish feed, fingerlings, and aerators
schemes.benefitHindi: तालाब निर्माण हेतु ₹1.60 लाख/हेक्टेयर सब्सिडी + बीज व दाना आहार हेतु ₹80,000 का अनुदान
schemes.description: Incentivizes commercial aquaculture and pond development on rural gram sabha leased ponds to raise farmer income in UP.
